target.statement: CoQAN achieves 0.924 accuracy on the self-media online article quality classification test set

compute.basis: Training hi-BERT (BERT fine-tuning) on 36k articles with max 32 sentences of 128 tokens each requires GPU; CPU-only would take days, and the dataset link may be dead.

blockers: No official code repository; only a Google Drive link for data, which may be inaccessible or outdated
Requires fine-tuning BERT, which is impractical on CPU within a few hours
Dataset contains Chinese articles and images; preprocessing (layout extraction, feature engineering) is complex and not fully specified
title: Cognitive Representation Learning of Self-Media Online Article Quality
